about_the_game:
Game Description:

In a 2D Side scrolling adventure, you are a fearless caveman riding through the untamed jungle on your trusty skateboard. As you speed through the wild terrain, be on the lookout for dangerous snakes, venomous spiders, and other hazardous obstacles. But don’t worry—you’re not defenseless! Armed with your mighty mace, you can smash through threats and clear your path.

The caveman has two powerful special attacks at his disposal. The first is a crushing strike with the mace, perfect for taking out close-range enemies. The second is the mighty SUPER CHARGE, which temporarily makes the caveman invincible, allowing him to plow through everything in his way without taking damage.

Your ultimate goal is to ride as far as you can through the jungle, all while collecting points and increasing your score. The longer you survive and the more enemies you defeat, the higher your score will climb. Challenge yourself to beat your personal best and become the ultimate jungle skater!

How To Play:

WSAD or arrow keys to move

WS - jump/crouch to avoid obstacles

AD - charge/mace attack to hit enemies

  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium g5420 / AMD FX 4300 or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 650 or higher
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 Series or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or higher
